c:capability.name: DeviceSettings
c:capability.c:description: Exposes device-specific configuration parameters (LED mode, power restore behavior, reporting thresholds, etc.) in a structured, discoverable way. Drivers declare available parameters via a DSL block; clients read metadata and current values through the params attribute and modify them via SetParam/GetParam methods.

c:attribute.name: params
c:attribute.description: List of parameter descriptors with metadata and current values.

c:method.name: GetParam
c:method.description: Read a parameter's current value from the device.
